name: virtual-streamdeck
description: Self-hosted, browser-based Stream Deck for OBS. Control OBS from any device on your LAN.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "cross-env PORT=3325 STREAMDECK_PUBLIC_PORT=5173 node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch server/index.ts" "vite --config web/vite.config.ts"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -k -n mock,server,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "node --watch server/dev/mock-obs.ts" "cross-env PORT=3325 STREAMDECK_PUBLIC_PORT=5173 STREAMDECK_DATA_DIR=.data-mock OBS_URL=ws://127.0.0.1:4456 OBS_PASSWORD= node --watch server/index.ts" "vite --config web/vite.config.ts"
